title: Figures 7-9: Ordinary Marx generator, Super Marx generator circuit and 1.5-km rendering
description: Circuit schematic 'Figure 7. Ordinary Marx Generator' shows HV input, capacitors C, resistors R and spark gaps S switching capacitors into series (V = nv). 'Figure 8. Super Marx Generator' is a multi-stage circuit of N Marx generators charging fast capacitors FC. 'Figure 9. Artist's Conception of a 1.5-km-Long Super Marx Generator' is a gray rendering of a long line of coaxial capacitors leading to a 'Fusion Target Chamber' with 'Marx Banks in Oil Tanks'.
